latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Keep doctrees and reST sources out of the published docs by @Kayvan-Zahiri in https://github.com/librosa/librosa/pull/2089
* making linkcheck failures not catastrophic for CI by @bmcfee in https://github.com/librosa/librosa/pull/2093
* Revising linkcheck action again by @bmcfee in https://github.com/librosa/librosa/pull/2098
* Forward `window` to stft and istft in effects.hpss, harmonic and percussive by @isaacsight in https://github.com/librosa/librosa/pull/2097
* Enable Ruff ARG unused-argument checks and resolve findings by @rajit-sareen in https://github.com/librosa/librosa/pull/2101
* Fix numpydoc lint glob to reach subpackages, reorder flagged sections, fix power_to_db axes docstring by @rajit-sareen in https://github.com/librosa/librosa/pull/2104
* Preserve float32 in spectral features; add dtype= to frequency constructors by @tritsystem in https://github.com/librosa/librosa/pull/2106
* Replace **kwargs with explicit STFT params in time_stretch/pitch_shift by @rajit-sareen in https://github.com/librosa/librosa/pull/2109
* Refactor/2021 display submodules by @MLsound in https://github.com/librosa/librosa/pull/2102
* Updates for CI by @bmcfee in https://github.com/librosa/librosa/pull/2113
* Add support for testing librosa on Windows ARM64 by @MugundanMCW in https://github.com/librosa/librosa/pull/2111
* Spec0 action and environment workflow modernization by @bmcfee in https://github.com/librosa/librosa/pull/2114
* fixing permissions on ci actions for codecov by @bmcfee in https://github.com/librosa/librosa/pull/2117
* Bump the github-actions group with 3 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/librosa/librosa/pull/2116
* Expose top_db on features that call power_to_db by @isaacsight in https://github.com/librosa/librosa/pull/2095
* Fix Numba TypingError when passing tuple intervals to effects.remix by @rishi02102017 in https://github.com/librosa/librosa/pull/2119
* Speed up matching for non-overlapping target intervals by @galleonli in https://github.com/librosa/librosa/pull/2112
* memory optimizations in piptrack, magphase, power_to_db, hpss, yin and pyin by @bmcfee in https://github.com/librosa/librosa/pull/2120
* util._nnls: use dtype-aware cutoff in pinv initialization by @bmcfee in https://github.com/librosa/librosa/pull/2122
* 1.0.1 release prep by @bmcfee in https://github.com/librosa/librosa/pull/2123

## New Contributors
* @isaacsight made their first contribution in https://github.com/librosa/librosa/pull/2097
* @rajit-sareen made their first contribution in https://github.com/librosa/librosa/pull/2101
* @tritsystem made their first contribution in https://github.com/librosa/librosa/pull/2106
* @MugundanMCW made their first contribution in https://github.com/librosa/librosa/pull/2111
* @dependabot[bot] made their first contribution in https://github.com/librosa/librosa/pull/2116
* @rishi02102017 made their first contribution in https://github.com/librosa/librosa/pull/2119
* @galleonli made their first contribution in https://github.com/librosa/librosa/pull/2112

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/librosa/librosa/compare/1.0.0...1.0.1
